answer: Let trust propagate through the attestation graph by random walks of bounded length, with voting weight derived from the resulting reachability. A sybil cluster joined to honest nodes by a sparse cut has low conductance, so only limited walk probability—and thus limited external trust—crosses into it; under capped attestations, this bounds its aggregate voting weight. Repeated endorsements may echo internally, but cannot turn a relic of isolated trust into a crystal of legitimacy.
